'''Point Tarron''' was a location.

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] was [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|captured]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] but soon [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescued]] by an elite team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] with the help of reprogrammed [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] including [[OOM-10/Legends|OOM-10]]. When OOM-10, as well as the other two battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]], tried escorting the what appeared to be a captured team to [[Shuttle 81572/Legends|shuttle 81572]] in order to escape, they were confronted by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] who asked where where the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] going. to which OOM-10 replied that they were being shifted to Point Tarron. But because there was no outpost on Point Tarron, the droid questioned OOM-10's statement.

==Behind the scenes==
The wording of the episode guide for [[Counterattack]] treats it that Point Tarron did not exist at all because the guide says Point Tarron was the made up outpost.
